user.title: Notification Center
user.description: Das Notification Center wird als einzelne, globale Instanz eingerichtet. Die Auswahl der zu ueberwachenden Entities erfolgt anschliessend im Notification-Center-Panel.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Es ist bereits eine Instanz des Notification Centers eingerichtet.

create.name: Create notification
create.description: Creates a notification. Calling again with the same owner and ID overwrites the existing notification instead of adding a second one.

entity_id.name: Entity
entity_id.description: Optional entity to open on click.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Optional. The notification ends by itself.

owner.name: Owner
owner.description: Optional. Defaults to the calling automation.

update.name: Update notification
update.description: Changes a running notification without adding a history entry.

init.title: Settings
init.description: These settings apply to the whole Notification Center.

data_description.retention_days: Older events are removed. Both limits apply at the same time.
data_description.max_events: When exceeded, the oldest finished events are removed.
data_description.analysis_days: How far back history analysis looks for rule suggestions.
data_description.paused: While paused no new notifications are created. Running ones remain.
